idx_t INFLOW_MAT_ID = 1;\nconstexpr idx_t OUTFLOW_MAT_ID = 2;\n\n// Build a 2D square grid as an unstructured mesh\n// This represents computation on arbitrarily-shaped geometries\nvoid world.elements_dynamic[i].current_energy = 0.0;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].total_flux = 0.0;\n    }\n    \n    // Build connectivity: each element connects to its neighbors in 2D grid\n    for (int x = 0; x < n_elems_root; ++x) {\n        for (int y = 0; y < n_elems_root; ++y) {\n            const int idx = x * n_elems_root + y;\n            ElementStatic& elem = world.elements_static[idx];\n            \n            // Connect to neighbors (up, down, left, right)\n            const int offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};\n            \n            for (int n = 0; n < 4; ++n) {\n                const int nx = x + offsets[n][0];\n                const int ny = y + offsets[n][1];\n                \n                // Check if neighbor is within bounds\n                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n_elems_root && ny >= 0 && ny < n_elems_root) {\n                    const int neighbor_idx = nx * n_elems_root + ny;\n                    elem.connected_idx[elem.num_connections] = neighbor_idx;\n                    elem.connected_flux[elem.num_connections] = 1.0;\n                    elem.num_connections++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Set corner elements as inflow/outflow to create interesting dynamics\n    const int last = n_elems_root - 1;\n    world.elements_static[0 * n_elems_root +  // Energy transfer coefficient\n    val_t external_flow;   // External energy source/sink\n};\n\n// Static connectivity information for each element\nstruct ElementStatic {\n    idx_t material_idx;\n    idx_t num_connections;\n    idx_t connected_idx[MAX_CONNECTIONS];     // Indices of connected elements\n    val_t connected_flux[MAX_CONNECTIONS];    // Flux coefficients for each connection\n};\n\n// Dynamic state for each element\nstruct ElementDynamic {\n    val_t current_energy;\n    val_t total_flux;\n};\n\n// World state\nstruct World {\n    std::vector<Material> materials;\n    std::vector<ElementStatic> elements_static;\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> elements_dynamic;\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> elements_dynamic_swap;\n};\n\n// Material type IDs\nconstexpr idx_t DEFAULT_MAT_ID = 0;\nconstexpr idx_t INFLOW_MAT_ID = 1;\nconstexpr idx_t OUTFLOW_MAT_ID = 2;\n\n// Build a 2D square grid as an unstructured mesh\n// This represents computation on arbitrarily-shaped geometries\nvoid buildSquare2D(World& world, const int n_elems_root) {\n    const int n_elems = n_elems_root * n_elems_root;\n    \n    // Initialize materials\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.0});    // Default material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.5});    // Inflow material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, -0.5});   // Outflow material\n    \n    // Allocate elements\n    world.elements_static.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic_swap.resize(n_elems);\n    \n    // Initialize all elements with default material and zero energy\n    for (int i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n        world.elements_static[i].material_idx = DEFAULT_MAT_ID;\n        world.elements_static[i].num_connections = 0;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].current_energy = 0.0;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].total_flux = 0.0;\n    }\n    \n    // Build connectivity: each element connects to its neighbors in 2D grid\n    for (int x = 0; x < n_elems_root; ++x) {\n        for (int y = 0; y < n_elems_root; ++y) {\n            const int idx = x * n_elems_root + y;\n            ElementStatic& elem = world.elements_static[idx];\n            \n            // Connect to neighbors (up, down, left, right)\n            const int offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};\n            \n            for (int n = 0; n < 4; ++n) {\n                const int nx = x + offsets[n][0];\n                const int ny = y + offsets[n][1];\n                \n                // Check if neighbor is within bounds\n                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n_elems_root && ny >= 0 && ny < n_elems_root) {\n                    const int neighbor_idx = nx * n_elems_root + ny;\n                    elem.connected_idx[elem.num_connections] = neighbor_idx;\n                    elem.connected_flux[elem.num_connections] = 1.0;\n                    elem.num_connections++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Set corner elements as inflow/outflow to create interesting dynamics\n    const int last = n_elems_root - 1;\n    world.elements_static[0 * n_elems_root + 0].material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[0 * n_elems_root + last].material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[last * n_elems_root + 0].material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[last * n_elems_root + last].material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n}\n\n// Check a CUDA runtime call and abort with a readable message on failure\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                           \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                           \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__, \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                               \\\n            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                              \\\n        }                                                                    \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Device-resident copy of the world. Connectivity is stored slot-major\n// (index = slot * n_elems + i) so consecutive threads read consecutive\n// addresses. Dynamic state is double-buffered: one buffer is read while the\n// other is written, then the roles swap.\nstruct DeviceWorld {\n    size_t n_elems = 0;\n    size_t n_slots = 0;\n    Material* materials = nullptr;\n    idx_t* material_idx = nullptr;\n    idx_t* num_connections = nullptr;\n    idx_t* connected_idx = nullptr;\n    val_t* connected_flux = nullptr;\n    val_t* energy[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    val_t* flux[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n};\n\ntemplate <typename T>\nT* deviceAlloc(size_t count) {\n    T* ptr = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ptr, count * sizeof(T)));\n    return ptr;\n}\n\ntemplate <typename T>\nT* toDevice(const std::vector<T>& host) {\n    T* ptr = deviceAlloc<T>(host.size());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ptr, host.data(), host.size() * sizeof(T), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    return ptr;\n}\n\n// Upload the mesh and its initial state to the GPU\nDeviceWorld uploadWorld(const World& world) {\n    DeviceWorld dw;\n    dw.n_elems = world.elements_static.size();\n    for (const auto& elem : world.elements_static) {\n        dw.n_slots = std::max<size_t>(dw.n_slots, elem.num_connections);\n    }\n    dw.n_slots = std::max<size_t>(dw.n_slots, 1);\n\n    const size_t n = dw.n_elems;\n    std::vector<idx_t> material_idx(n);\n    std::vector<idx_t> num_connections(n);\n    std::vector<idx_t> connected_idx(dw.n_slots * n, 0);\n    std::vector<val_t> connected_flux(dw.n_slots * n, 0.0);\n    std::vector<val_t> energy(n);\n    std::vector<val_t> flux(n);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const ElementStatic& elem_static = world.elements_static[i];\n        material_idx[i] = elem_static.material_idx;\n        num_connections[i] = elem_static.num_connections;\n        for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {\n            connected_idx[j * n + i] = elem_static.connected_idx[j];\n            connected_flux[j * n + i] = elem_static.connected_flux[j];\n        }\n        energy[i] = world.elements_dynamic[i].current_energy;\n        flux[i] = world.elements_dynamic[i].total_flux;\n    }\n\n    dw.materials = toDevice(world.materials);\n    dw.material_idx = toDevice(material_idx);\n    dw.num_connections = toDevice(num_connections);\n    dw.connected_idx = toDevice(connected_idx);\n    dw.connected_flux = toDevice(connected_flux);\n    dw.energy[0] = toDevice(energy);\n    dw.flux[0] = toDevice(flux);\n    // The first step writes every element of the second buffer before reading it\n    dw.energy[1] = deviceAlloc<val_t>(n);\n    dw.flux[1] = deviceAlloc<val_t>(n);\n    return dw;\n}\n\n// Compute energy flux between two elements (same operation order as the serial reference)\n__device__ __forceinline__ val_t computeFlux(val_t transfer_coeff, val_t this_energy,\n                                             val_t connection_flux, val_t other_energy) {\n    return (other_energy - this_energy) * transfer_coeff * connection_flux * 0.25;\n}\n\n// One simulation step: each thread updates one element from buffer 'cur' and\n// writes buffer '1 - cur'. index of the dynamic buffer that holds the final state.\nint runSimulation(const DeviceWorld& dw, const int n_iters) {\n    constexpr unsigned threads_per_block = 256;\n    const unsigned n_blocks = static_cast<unsigned>((dw.n_elems + threads_per_block - 1) / threads_per_block);\n\n    int cur = 0;\n    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n        stepKernel<<<n_blocks, threads_per_block>>>(dw, cur);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        cur = 1 - cur;\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    return cur;\n}\n\n// Copy the final dynamic state back into the host world\nvoid downloadWorld(const DeviceWorld& dw, const int cur, World& world) {\n    std::vector<val_t> energy(dw.n_elems);\n    std::vector<val_t> flux(dw.n_elems);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(energy.data(), dw.energy[cur], dw.n_elems * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(flux.data(), dw.flux[cur], dw.n_elems * sizeof(val_t), {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1aqSq2xupYT33232SiV","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The benchmark's simulation now runs as a CUDA kernel, and the program requires a GPU. Output matches the original bit-for-bit, and it's about 23–36× faster on the same inputs.\n\n**Results (RTX 3090, `-i 10` unless noted)**\n\n| Grid | Original | CUDA |\n|---|---|---|\n| 512² | 23 ms | 1 ms |\n| 2048² | 379 ms | 11 ms |\n| 4096² | 1599 ms | 44 ms |\n| 4096², `-i 100` | 16002 ms | 442 ms |\n\nThe printed result hashes and full `-r` output match the original for grids 1×1 through 512², with 0–100 iterations. The check ran against the original built with default and with FMA contraction disabled, and both matched. `compute-sanitizer` memcheck reports 0 errors.\n\n**What changed**\n- `unstructured/unstructured.cpp`:\n  - The per-element update is a `__global__` kernel, one thread per element, double-buffered like the original swap.\n  - Connectivity is stored structure-of-arrays on the device, slot-major, so neighbor reads coalesce.\n  - The arithmetic keeps the original expression order.\n  - Mesh building, validation, hashing, and result printing are unchanged and still run on the host.\n- `unstructured/CMakeLists.txt`: enables the CUDA language, compiles this file with nvcc, targets `native` GPU architecture, adds `--fmad=false`, and links `CUDA::cudart`. The executable name is unchanged.\n- No new files in the repo. Build artifacts and the baseline copy are in `/tmp`.\n\n**Choices I made**\n- **Timed scope:** the timer covers only the iteration loop and its synchronization, which is what the original timed. Upload and final download are outside it, like mesh building and output already are. The CUDA context is created during the untimed upload.\n- **`--fmad=false`:** keeps device arithmetic as plain IEEE multiply/add so it matches the original's rounding order.\n- **No CPU fallback:** as requested, the program always uses CUDA. Without a visible GPU it prints a CUDA error and exits with code 1.\n- **Launch config:** 256 threads per block, one kernel launch per iteration.\n\n**Requirements:** CMake ≥ 3.24 (for `native`) and the CUDA toolkit. Note the default `nvcc` here is 12.0, and I built with it.\n\nI didn't commit anything, since the directory isn't a git repo and you didn't ask for a commit."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":495,"cache_read_input_tokens":58159,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":495},"output_tokens":9,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"4f43d80f-a731-48b9-bd5a-ac3a5df7f777","uuid":"fd54568a-89b3-4a56-bc54-43c05fe1b70d","timestamp":"2026-10-14T05:33:40.279Z","request_id":"req_011Cg1aqSXgV6CoBrUv1G6By"}
